title: Chat generation and Claude image inputs got their footing back
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: chat fixes, Claude compatibility, a filled-in news archive, and smoother community workflows.

Chat.pollinations.ai generation was restored, Claude Code gained routing support, and Claude/Bedrock image URLs are now converted cleanly to base64. Less ceremony between a prompt, an image, and a usable response.

News files from late July through early December were backfilled, alongside a workflow and pipeline for keeping updates flowing and a fix for branch filtering. The changelog is becoming less of an archaeological dig.

Adding the app:review label now reliably starts the app-submission workflow, and Lily, an AI Discord companion, joined the socialBots directory.
